method: pdftotext -layout extraction of Indian Schedule-2 chapter PDFs, then grep for both NNNN.NN and NNNNNN code formats with surrounding context
notes: Indian Schedule-2 PDFs use 8-digit ITC-HS codes without dots (e.g. '29313300'). The Indian tariff is largely aligned with WCO HS 2017 with India-specific 8-digit tariff lines; it has NOT adopted several HS 2022 subheading splits. Column wrap in pdftotext output sometimes shifts descriptions, but the presence/absence of the 8-digit code itself is unambiguous.

set_a_ours_only.pdf_evidence:
29313300  Phosphorothioic acid, S2 (diethyl amino) ethyl] O, O-        Free
29314100  Diethyl ester
set_a_ours_only.reasoning: 8-digit code 29313300 appears in Chapter 29 PDF as a real tariff line with 'Free' policy. The pdftotext column-wrap jumbles the description (text 'Phosphorothioic acid...' belongs to a neighboring row), but the code itself is unambiguously present in the Indian schedule. India retains 2931.33 as an organophosphorus subheading; legitimate India-specific entry.

set_b_wco_only.pdf_evidence: not found. Codes present under 1211: 12112000, 12113000, 12114000, 12116000, 121190 (with 12119011..12119090 children). No 1211.50 or 12115xxxx anywhere in the chapter.
set_b_wco_only.reasoning: WCO HS 2022 added 1211.50 'Ephedra' as a new subheading. The Indian Schedule-2 PDF has not been updated to include it — it jumps from 1211.40 (Poppy straw) to 1211.60 (Bark of African cherry) under 121190. Extractor did not miss anything; India simply lags behind HS 2022.

set_b_wco_only.pdf_evidence: not found. Codes present under 2712: 271210, 27121010, 27121090, 271290, 27129010..27129090. No 2712.20 or 27122xxx anywhere in Chapter 27.
set_b_wco_only.reasoning: WCO HS 2022 split paraffin wax into 2712.20 (<0.75% oil) and 2712.90 (Other). Indian PDF still uses pre-2022 structure with only 2712.10 (Petroleum jelly) and 2712.90 (Other). Not a missed extraction; the code is genuinely absent from India's tariff.

WCO HS 2022 added 3006.92 'Waste pharmaceuticals'. The Indian PDF lists 3006.91 and 3006.93 but skips 3006.92 entirely. Not an extractor bug — the Indian tariff has not adopted this HS 2022 subheading.

set_b_wco_only.pdf_evidence: not found. Codes present under 4402: 44021000 (Of bamboo), 440220 (Of shell or nut), 44022010 (Of coconut shell), 44022090 (Other). No 4402.90 or 44029xxx anywhere in Chapter 44.
set_b_wco_only.reasoning: WCO HS 2022 has 4402.10 (bamboo), 4402.20 (shell/nut), 4402.90 (Other) for wood charcoal. Indian PDF stops at 4402.20 — no 'Other' 4402.90 catch-all. Not a missed row; India's tariff simply lacks this subheading.

WCO HS has 4802.40 'Wallpaper base'. The Indian PDF's 4802 series skips directly from 4802.20 (Hand-made paper) to 4802.54 (weighing less than 40 g/m²). Wallpaper base 4802.40 is not present as a row. Extractor did not miss it.

WCO HS has 5516.24 'Printed' under the '85% or more artificial staple fibres' group. The Indian PDF's structure for this group lists 5516.11/.12/.13/.14 (unbleached, bleached, dyed, of different colours) but lacks a 5516.24 'Printed' row. Likely a difference in how India numbered the printed variant. Not an extractor bug.

summary.pattern: Set A: every code our extractor produced that is absent from WCO HS 2022 IS present in the Indian Schedule-2 PDF — these are India-specific retentions of pre-HS-2022 subheadings (3002.10, 4401.10) or India-specific tariff lines (2931.33, 2937.31, 3301.22). Zero phantoms. Set B: every code WCO HS 2022 added that is absent from our extraction is also absent from the Indian PDF — India's tariff has not yet adopted the 2022 splits (1211.50 Ephedra, 2712.20 paraffin-wax-low-oil, 3006.92 waste-pharma, 4402.90 other-charcoal, 4802.40 wallpaper-base, 5516.24 printed). Extractor is faithful to source; the gap is between India's tariff and WCO HS 2022, not between our extraction and India's tariff.
